sources.prompt: Photorealistic Swiss alpine botanical 2x2 alpha atlas: isolated hazel, autumn wild rose with hips, bilberry, cream-flowering dwarf shrub; complete branch silhouettes, transparent margins, no text. Applied on lit intersecting shrub planes and on renewable coppice foliage.

Realistic autumn Swiss mountainbike park: forest-green full-suspension bike, disc brakes, gold forks, curved braced timber takeoff, broad dirt landing, successive jumps, larches/firs/meadow, broad limestone peaks and valley. No rider or text. Used as selectable park preview and design reference for actual 3D bike/ramp/vegetation implementation.

note: Full source PNGs and retained original media live in this source tree. Preview is not a game screenshot. Runtime WebP images compressed for mobile delivery.
